title: The Protocol of Marseille's old port Again
premise: Isandro Galloway, a disgraced financial-crimes investigator hiding in Marseille under a new name, is pulled back into the game when a voiceprint—his own, harvested from a recording he never made—unlocks a server in Singapore containing proof that the 'clean money' he once laundered for a cartel was actually funding a witness-protection black market. The server's owner, defector Mei-Lin Zhao, offers him the truth in exchange for extraction before dawn, but Isandro's old handler, Odile, warns him that Mei-Lin may be bait designed to flush out everyone who betrayed the network. Torn between loyalty to Odile, who once saved his life, and the truth Mei-Lin carries about the night his family disappeared, Isandro runs the extraction through the old port's smuggling routes. At the airfield, he learns Mei-Lin and Odile were both pawns of the same broker—and Isandro chooses truth over survival, burning the network's ledgers publicly, saving Mei-Lin, and finally sleeping through the night.
about_author: Cyrus Blackwood is the pen name of a former compliance officer who spent eleven years tracing money through ports from Rotterdam to Singapore before walking away to write. They live within earshot of a harbor and claim to sleep fine.

chapters.title: Salt and Ledger Lines
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Two years after the incident, Isandro audits clean money for a Marseille shipping firm by day and counts ceiling cracks by night, haunted by insomnia and a voice he can't place from the recording of his family's disappearance. When his firm's systems flag an impossible transaction, he recognizes his own voiceprint in the authentication log. Emotional beat: the fragile lie of his invisibility cracking.

chapters.title: The Server That Knows My Voice
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Following the voiceprint trail, Isandro reaches a dormant server in Singapore that unlocks to a synthesized sample of his voice and displays a countdown: seventy-two hours. Inside is a partial ledger linking his old cases to a black-market trade in protected witnesses. Emotional beat: dread curdling into obsession—the past has been waiting for him.

chapters.title: Odile at the Bar des Docks
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Isandro risks everything by contacting Odile Ferrand, his former handler, who now runs a waterfront bar. She warns him the server is a trap set by someone called the Broker, and that the woman behind it—Mei-Lin Zhao—is either the last honest witness or the perfect lure. Emotional beat: the warmth and suspicion of a found-family reunion under strain.

chapters.title: Mei-Lin
chapters.summary: POV Mei-Lin. In a safehouse above the old port, Mei-Lin reviews the ledger she stole from the Broker's network, which names the officials who sold protected witnesses—including, she believes, whoever orchestrated the incident that broke Isandro. She initiates contact with Isandro, offering the full truth for one dawn extraction. Emotional beat: calculated hope; she needs him as much as he needs her.

chapters.title: What the Clean Money Bought
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Meeting Mei-Lin in a fish market at closing, Isandro sees his own case numbers in her ledger and learns the money he 'cleaned' purchased silence, not safety. She claims Odile signed off on one of the transfers. Emotional beat: betrayal—loyalty and truth become opposites for the first time.

chapters.title: Seventy-Two Hours, Fifty-Six Left
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. Isandro confronts Odile, who admits signing transfers but insists she did it to protect Isandro from the Broker, trading favors to keep his name off lists. She gives him a smuggling contact and a warning: the Broker already knows Mei-Lin is in Marseille. Emotional beat: forgiveness offered but not yet accepted; loyalty reasserting itself.

chapters.title: The Port Wakes Up
chapters.summary: POV Mei-Lin. The Broker's men hit the safehouse; Mei-Lin escapes through the old port's tunnels with the ledger drive, guided by Odile's smuggler, while Isandro draws pursuers away through the fish market. The extraction plan moves up: wheels up at dawn from a private strip outside Marignane. Emotional beat: found family forged under fire—strangers now covering for each other.

chapters.title: The Broker's Offer
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The Broker contacts Isandro directly: hand over Mei-Lin and the drive, and he'll return the missing piece of the recording—the truth of who ordered the incident. Isandro, sleepless and raw, nearly accepts, then hears in the Broker's synthesized voice the same vocal signature from his nightmares. Emotional beat: the seduction of easy survival versus the price of truth.

chapters.title: Dawn at Marignane
chapters.summary: POV Isandro and Mei-Lin alternating. At the airfield, Isandro discovers Odile is already there—she brokered the flight, and the Broker expected it; Mei-Lin was bait to draw out every traitor and loyalist at once. Isandro turns the trap: he broadcasts the ledger to every news desk and regulator on Mei-Lin's list before the Broker can kill them, making the truth too public to bury. Emotional beat: climax—choosing truth over the promise of getting his old life back.

chapters.title: Sleeping Through the Night
chapters.summary: POV Isandro. The Broker's network collapses as arrests ripple across three continents; Odile, exposed but protected by her cooperation, pours Isandro a drink at the bar and calls him family without irony. Mei-Lin boards her own flight to a new life, leaving Isandro the full recording—the incident was never his fault. That night in Marseille, he sleeps until the harbor bells. Emotional beat: resolution—the price was paid, and survival finally feels like living.
